page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines. The mirrored lines faintly visible through the paper are show-through and are left out.
page.notes: The title is set in large spaced capitals, partly faded. The decorative ornament in the middle of the page is an engraving or woodcut and is not text. The line "Medici Parisiensis" and the line "De impera" are hard to read at this scan quality. The date is read as M. DC. LXXV, which is uncertain. Some letters in the upper lines are very faint.
